title.purpose: Lámina titles and title-block values in condensed uppercase.

body.purpose: Readable sentences in Barlow, capped near 46-62ch.

label.purpose: Field names, legend heading, table headers, group headers.

shadows.name: stamp-lift
shadows.purpose: The approval stamp, the only object raised above the sheet.

motion.purpose: Plan linework drawing in (1.6s wall, 2s railway after 0.9s) and stamp lift (0.25s).

components.name: Approval Stamp
components.description: The single call to action, a tilted orange stamped box.
components.html: Afíliate: busca a un dirigente
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: block; text-decoration: none; color: var(--paper, #f1ede2); background: var(--orange, #c9461a); padding: 18px 20px 20px; border: 2px solid #1b2330; outline: 2px solid #c9461a; outline-offset: 4px; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -8px #1b2330a0; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); max-width: 360px; } .ds-stamp b { display: block; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-stamp:hover, .ds-stamp:focus-visible { transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 20px -8px #1b2330b0; } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c9461a; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Lámina
components.description: One numbered program item: numeral, uppercase title, one sentence.
components.html:
05

Perland Village, país

Convertir Perland Village en una potencia continental y en un país.
components.css: .ds-lamina { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr; gap: 6px 18px; padding: 18px 24px 20px; background: #f1ede2; color: #1b2330; border-bottom: 1px solid #1b233033; transition: background-color 0.2s; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-lamina:hover, .ds-lamina:focus-visible { background: #e6e0d0; } .ds-lamina:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c9461a; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-lamina .ds-n { grid-row: span 2; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 0.85; color: #c9461a; } .ds-lamina h4 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-lamina p { margin: 0; color: #3d4757; max-width: 46ch; }

components.name: Group Header
components.description: Ink bar naming a group of láminas with its color swatch.
components.css: .ds-group { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 24px; background: #1b2330; color: #f1ede2; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-group i { display: block; width: 28px; height: 8px; background: #c9461a; outline: 1px solid #f1ede2; }

components.name: Title Block Field
components.description: A ruled title-block cell: label over value.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 14px 24px 16px; border: 1px solid #1b2330; background: #f1ede2; color: #1b2330; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #3d4757; } .ds-value { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.15; }

components.name: Revision Table
components.description: Fe de erratas: ruled table with a label-type header row.
components.css: .ds-rev { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; border: 2px solid #1b2330; } .ds-rev th, .ds-rev td { text-align: left; padding: 10px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1b2330; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-rev th { background: #e6e0d0; color: #3d4757; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Falso Mark
components.description: Orange outlined rubber-stamp mark for a refuted claim.
components.css: .ds-falso { display: inline-block; border: 3px solid #c9461a; color: #c9461a; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.6rem; transform: rotate(-3deg); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Signature Box Field
components.description: Ruled fill-in cell: label above a dashed underline holding the value.
components.css: .ds-casilla { display: grid; gap: 22px; align-content: space-between; min-height: 104px; padding: 18px 24px 14px; border: 1px solid #1b2330; background: #f1ede2; } .ds-casilla .ds-label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #3d4757; } .ds-v { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; min-height: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed #1b2330; color: #1b2330; }

components.name: Legend Row
components.description: Legend entry: 56x18 line swatch beside condensed name; the plan's index.

narrative.overview:
The site is a civil-works drawing, not a campaign page. One hairline-framed sheet of warm paper holds a title block, a plan of the nation, a register of twelve numbered láminas, a revision note, and a signature box. Every surface is a cell of that drawing; nothing floats off it. Ink is a single near-black blue, with two working colors that each mean one thing: signal orange for the wall and the approval, rail teal for the railway.

Density is that of technical documentation: ruled cells, tabular numerals, condensed drawing lettering, line weights doing the work that cards and shadows do elsewhere. The page is a document to be read and checked, in the voice of a movement addressing neighbours. Linework is drawn at 45 and 90 degrees only, and the plan draws itself on load (wall first, railway second).
keyCharacteristics: One framed sheet on a slightly deeper paper desk; ruled cells instead of cards.
Ink for structure and text, orange and teal reserved for plan meaning.
Condensed uppercase lettering for everything that is "drawn", plain humanist Barlow for reading.
Zero radius everywhere; the only tilt is a rubber-stamp gesture.
Information is shown as plan geometry first; hover on a lámina highlights its feature in the drawing.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Orange means wall or approval; teal means railway. A new color is added only when the plan gains a new kind of thing to draw.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every line, border and text block is Delineator Ink or Soft Ink. No tints of other hues for structure.

rules.name: The Drawn-or-Read Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels, numbers or titles is condensed and uppercase; anything meant to be read as a sentence is Barlow in sentence case.

rules.name: The Halo Lettering Rule
rules.body: Text laid over linework in the plan gets a 5px paper stroke painted underneath so it stays legible across lines.

rules.name: The One Raised Object Rule
rules.body: Only the approval stamp lifts off the sheet. Everything else is printed on it.

dos: Do divide space with ink rules (2px for bands, 1px for cells) instead of gaps, shadows or cards.
Do draw new features in the plan at 45 or 90 degrees, in ink unless they are a wall (orange) or a railway (teal).
Do set titles, numerals and field names in condensed uppercase; set sentences in Barlow.
Do keep orange text at 1.6rem or larger, or as line and fill only.
Do keep body copy at or under 62ch.
Do run decorative motion through prefers-reduced-motion handling.
donts: Don't add border radius, gradients for decoration, or blur.
Don't introduce a third signal color without a new kind of plan feature to carry it.
Don't raise anything other than the approval stamp.
Don't convert láminas into cards, a hero with tagline and CTA row, or an icon grid.
Don't hard-code new hex values in SVG; add or reuse a named color.
